## What happened?

Describe expected and actual behavior. English and Russian are welcome.
Use this form for ordinary bugs only. A private reporting destination is still
awaiting maintainer confirmation; don't post sensitive findings here.

## Reproduce

List the steps from launch, including the tab or player action involved.

## Environment

Include app version or source commit, install method, computer OS, TV model,
firmware/Tizen version, and whether this happened in a browser or on the TV.
For media failures, identify the title/episode, quality, and audio/subtitle choice
without an authenticated stream URL. State whether real picture/sound was checked.

## Evidence

Add sanitized error text or screenshots and reproducibility frequency. Remove
account names/data, passwords, access/refresh tokens, device codes, DUIDs, signed
stream URLs, certificates, and private keys before attaching logs or traces.
